result.title: MediaStormBench-CameraLog: Can Multimodal Models Identify a Camera's Log Curve?
result.summary: MediaStormBench is a multimodal benchmark for real-world film and television production, with each subset drawn from MediaStorm's day-to-day work. We release its first subset, MediaStormBench-CameraLog (CameraLogBench), on a common foundational task in footage ingest and initial color grading: identifying the Log curve of a clip without metadata. Cameras record Log footage by compressing a wide range of scene light into code values with a vendor-defined logarithmic curve, and color can be restored correctly only once that curve is known. The curve, however, is recorded only in file metadata, easily lost in transcoding and team hand-offs. A colorist then has to try candidate curves one by one against a waveform scope, and a wrong choice shifts the tones and colors of the whole clip. Recovering the curve from the image alone is challenging, because vendor curves cluster tightly in code value and are coupled with unknown exposure. CameraLogBench is built on professionally shot footage and tests whether multimodal models can identify the curve, with a probe that removes the correct option to expose guessing from priors. Because every candidate curve is strictly defined by a published vendor formula, we derive four controls from one implementation of these formulas: graded negatives, synthetic frames of identical scenes, in-context specification digests, and a training-free formula baseline, which together decouple semantic priors from photometric measurement. Across 11 models, real-footage accuracy barely exceeds always guessing the most frequent curve; when the correct option is removed, models almost never abstain, revealing heavy reliance on scene and brand priors. Supplying the vendor specification sharply improves recognition on calibrated charts but hardly helps on natural images without a photometric reference, exposing a gap between reading a specification and measuring pixels.

AI.brief_summary: 论文发布 CameraLogBench，一个取材于影视制作实务的多模态基准，测试模型能否在缺少元数据时仅凭画面判断视频的 Log 曲线，并通过去除正确选项、同场景合成帧、供应商规格摘要和无训练公式基线等控制，区分语义先验与真实光度测量。
AI.relevance_reason: 结果显示模型准确率仅略高于猜最常见曲线、移除正确选项后几乎不弃答，且规格提示对自然图像帮助有限，这种「是否真的测量像素而非走先验」的诊断协议（含强制弃答探针）可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据是否进入内部状态、以及视觉旁路与先验坍缩的评估。
